messages:
Eve Liao: Heads-up: Planning to cut release/1.10 tomorrow 2025-03-18 10:00 PT (18:00 UTC). Please post any backport requests, cherry-pick PRs, or blocker notes here. If you need a branch created early, say so. TL;DR: cutoff is EOD today 23:59 PT for non-critical changes. :clock10:
Sam Ortiz: Can we allow dependency updates that only change go.mod? I have #4521 that bumps grpc. Low risk.
Priya Singh: I'd prefer to keep dependency bumps out unless security. Can you add rationale + test run? If it's just go.mod and CI passed, maybe ok. @Sam Ortiz please add 'release-allow' label if you think it's safe.
Sam Ortiz: Will run CI now and add label if green.
release-bot: release-bot: Reminder: add 'release-allow' or 'changelog/*' labels for branch-cut consideration. See https://redwood.internal/release-guidelines
Jamal Carter: Heads up — need backport for #4490 (fix deadlock in kv cache). This must go in 1.10. PR: #4556 (cherry-pick candidate). @Eve Liao please include in branch.
Eve Liao: Added to list. @Maya Chen can you help review #4556 quickly? We want to avoid rework during cut.
Maya Chen: On it, will review today. If I need changes, I'll mark for next patch only.
Victor Alvarez: Question on branching: Do we create release/1.10 from main or from staging? I think main already has the version bump commit.
Eve Liao: Create from main. Our procedure: main -> release/*, then minor version bump on release branch. I'll run the git commands once we confirm list.
Priya Singh: Also reminder: changelog entries must be in PRs with 'changelog/added' or 'changelog/fix' label before cutoff. QA will pull entries from labels.
Sam Ortiz: CI passed for #4521, added 'release-allow' and 'changelog/infra' labels. @Eve Liao PTAL.
Eve Liao: Thanks. I'll create branch at 10:00 PT and post the branch sha. Quick checklist I'm following: 1) freeze merges to main except security; 2) create release/1.10; 3) cherry-pick tagged PRs; 4) bump version in package; 5) run full e2e. If anyone needs an emergency backport after cut, comment here and we'll triage.
Jamal Carter: Posting the cherry-pick command I'll use for #4556:
``
git checkout -b backport/1.10-4490 origin/main
git cherry-pick -x abcdef123
git push origin backport/1.10-4490
```
Maya Chen: Reviewed #4556. small nit fixed. PR updated.
release-bot: release-bot: Branch release/1.10 created by @Eve Liao at sha: f2a9d3e. Locking main for non-security merges.
Eve Liao: Branch created and lock applied. I'll open a tracking PR to merge cherry-picks into release/1.10. Thanks everyone — will post final cut status after e2e.
